question: give district wise pp increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district

```sql
SELECT
  a.district,
  (100.0 * b.anc4_completed / b.pregnancies_registered)
  - (100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered) AS pp_increase
FROM anc_visits a
JOIN anc_visits b
  ON a.district = b.district
WHERE a.year = 2021
  AND b.year = 2023
  AND a.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda');
```
